summary.tldr: Amends the Veterans Well-being Act to let rehabilitation services for veterans include service dogs.
what_it_does: Adds service dogs as a possible rehabilitation service under the Veterans Well-being Act.
Requires the Minister, when making a rehabilitation plan, to assess whether a veteran's medical or psycho-social needs require a service dog.
Allows the Minister to make regulations, after consulting the provinces, on service dog health, breeding, training, testing, certification, financing, and related matters.
Defines a service dog as a dog trained by an organisation that specialises in service dog training to help with physical, psychological, or social adjustment needs.
summary.background: The bill amends the Veterans Well-being Act. It adds a new section saying rehabilitation services under that Act may include service dogs.
